summary: OppFi Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire BNCCORP, Inc. via a merger. BNCC will merge into a subsidiary, and its bank subsidiary will be renamed OppFi Bank, N.A. Each BNCC share will be converted into $19.375 cash plus 1.90 OppFi Class A shares. Based on OppFi's closing price on April 28, 2026, the transaction is valued at approximately $130.7 million. Post-close, OppFi stockholders will own ~93% and former BNCC stockholders ~7%. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal. Closing is subject to BNCC stockholder approval, regulatory approvals from the OCC and Federal Reserve, and other customary conditions. The acquisition gives OppFi a bank charter, allowing it to bring operations in-house; watch for regulatory timeline and margin upside from the vertical integration.
